M.build_note: -m 2: this collection holds 9 unique sequences spread over several genera, so no cluster reaches the documented floor of 5 and the feature builds zero profiles at it. The identity floor -mi 0.8 is unchanged, so a profile still rests on sequences that are 80% identical.
M.note: ORF3 membrane protein, triple-transmembrane, 225-245 aa (PMID 16987966, PMID 22422065).

MPRO.anno: Main protease involved in polyprotein cleavage
MPRO.note: The bafinivirus main protease, cut from pp1a by anchoring on the protein whose ends were sequenced -- white bream virus pp1a 3443-3709, the N1-C1 marker of PMID 21068254 -- and snapping each boundary to the nearest Gln|(Ala,Thr,Ser), that protease's published consensus. All four of its autoprocessing sites were mapped by Edman degradation: N1 Gln3442|Ala3443 (ITRQ|ALQR, predominant), N2 Gln3449|Ala3450, C1 Gln3709|Thr3710 (VTQQ|TSVT) and C2 Gln3716|Thr3717; catalytic triad Ser3589-His3492-Asp3518. Measured here over the collection: 5 of 6 pp1a sequences yield a product, P1 is Gln at 100% at both ends, products 267-275 aa. The sixth is refused rather than guessed -- no Gln|(Ala,Thr,Ser) within 12 residues of the projected boundary.

ORF1AB.build_note: min_len/max_len in amino acids, from the 11 transcript_edit references this build wrote: observed 6643-7174 aa, with 10% slack either side.
ORF1AB.note: Expressed by -1 ribosomal frameshifting; ORF1b carries the RdRp, helicase, ribose-methyltransferase, exoribonuclease and NendoU (PMID 16987966). The slippery heptamer is UUUAAAC: NC_008516 misc_feature 14549..14555, CDS join(906..14555,14555..21523). No PSSM.
